description: Register a new track inside an existing upload session. Returns status action_required / PUT_AUDIO_BYTES with track_upload.upload_url — the audio is NOT stored until you PUT the bytes. A cover image target is returned at track_cover_upload. Call once per file. The upload URL is short-lived — do not store or cache it. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_create_track_in_upload_session
